entities.summary: The lands surrounding the Mediterranean Sea — from Iberia to the Levant, from North Africa to southern Europe — that constituted the geopolitical center of the ancient and medieval world. The Mediterranean enabled trade, colonization, and cultural exchange among Phoenician, Greek, Roman, Byzantine, and Islamic civilizations, making it history's most consequential maritime corridor.
